mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(A.BASIC_CODE, 'N') FROM TB_BASICSCHEDULE A JOIN TB_CENTERINFO B ON A.CENTER_ID = B.CENTER_ID JOIN TB_DIDINFO C ON A.CENTER_ID = C.CENTER_ID WHERE A.CREATE_CHECK = 'Y' AND A.DID_DOWNCHECK = 'N' AND C.DID_ID = #{didId} AND TRIM(C.DID_MAC) = #{didMac} LIMIT 1

SELECT A.CENTER_ID, A.CENTER_NM, C.BASIC_CODE, C.BASIC_GROUP_NM FROM TB_CENTERINFO A JOIN TB_BRODSCHEDULE B ON A.CENTER_ID = B.CENTER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_BRODBASICGROUP C ON B.BASIC_FILE_ID = C.BASIC_CODE WHERE A.CENTER_GUBUN = #{centerGubun} ORDER BY A.CENTER_ID DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_BASICSCHEDULE ( BASIC_SCHEDULE_SEQ, CENTER_ID, BASIC_CODE, CREATE_CHECK, CREATE_REGDATE ) VALUES ( NEXTVAL('basicbrodsechedule_seq'), #{centerId}, #{basicCode}, #{createCheck}, NOW() )

INSERT INTO TB_BASICSCHEDULE ( BASIC_SCHEDULE_SEQ, CENTER_ID, BASIC_CODE, CREATE_CHECK, CREATE_REGDATE ) SELECT NEXTVAL('basicbrodsechedule_seq'), A.CENTER_ID, A.BASIC_FILE_ID, 'Y', NOW() FROM TB_BRODSCHEDULE A JOIN TB_CENTERINFO B ON A.CENTER_ID = B.CENTER_ID WHERE A.BASIC_FILE_ID = #{basicCode}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_BASICSCHEDULE SET CREATE_CHECK = 'E', CREATE_REGDATE = NULL, DID_DOWNCHECK = 'N', DID_DOWNLOADDATE = NULL WHERE BASIC_CODE = #{basicCode}
UPDATE TB_BASICSCHEDULE SET CREATE_CHECK = 'Y', CREATE_REGDATE = NOW(), DID_DOWNCHECK = 'N', DID_DOWNLOADDATE = NULL WHERE BASIC_SCHEDULE_SEQ = #{basicScheduleSeq}
